description: Paid $1.00 USD. Build the broad released multi-source property package with completeness, source gaps, provenance, and repeat-poll guidance through check_property_changes. state.description: Optional state name or abbreviation. Current released jurisdictions are in California; use CA or California.

unit.description: Optional unit, suite, or apartment identifier when it is relevant to property identity.
